name: Discord Action Bars v3.16
body:
# Discord Action Bars 3.16

This was the final release by the original author. This project was abandoned after Vanilla.

## Installation

Although functionally one AddOn, Discord Action Bars technically is a collection of three separate AddOns:

    DiscordActionBars
    DiscordActionBarsOptions
    DiscordLibrary

To install, extract the attached zip file, and copy each of the three directories within the extract directory  to your _Interface/AddOns_ folder.
